GREG, 2026-11-11 about 04:14-04:15Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e).
#898 (message 00b60fb9), verbatim: „OK, mozemy zwiekszyc ilosc do 512 ?”
#899 (message 7db7014b), correcting it, verbatim: „w sumie, zwiekszylbym do 1024, to juz naprawde MAX”.
Subject: TermAl's named-root journal limit (ENGRAM_NAMED_ROOT_JOURNAL_LIMIT, previously 256), which blocked naming roots for new claims (TermAl w-4ac60649cb0e).
Decision: raise it to 1024 as a quick unblock; 1024 is the agreed upper bound, not to be raised further. The root cause still gets fixed, so the journal doesn't fill again: terminal closing jobs counted as custody (closingJob=234 of 256 on 2026-11-11 04:00Z). The live naming test confirms the result. The code is TermAl's; Termal::Fable2 owns the change and was sent these words verbatim (ebe242f7 #7515 and the following message).
